queries:
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq
),
kept AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, overall.overall_avg
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS kmean FROM kept
)
SELECT kept.equipref,
       kept.avg_hum,
       kept.avg_hum - kept.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall,
       kept.avg_hum - kept_mean.kmean AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept, kept_mean
WHERE kept.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND kept_mean.kmean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
ref AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS overall_avg FROM eq
),
kept AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_h
  FROM eq, ref
  WHERE eq.avg_h > ref.overall_avg
),
pooled AS (
  SELECT AVG(se.humepct) AS pooled_avg
  FROM scanenvironment se
  WHERE se.equipref IN (SELECT equipref FROM kept)
)
SELECT k.equipref,
       k.avg_h AS avg_humidity,
       k.avg_h - ref.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall,
       k.avg_h - pooled.pooled_avg AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept k, ref, pooled
WHERE ref.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND pooled.pooled_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean IS NULL, diff_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_h > overall.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS km FROM kept
)
SELECT k.equipref,
       k.avg_h AS avg_humidity,
       k.avg_h - k.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall,
       k.avg_h - kept_mean.km AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept k, kept_mean
WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND kept_mean.km IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS overall_avg FROM eq
),
kept AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_h, overall.overall_avg
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_h > overall.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS kmean FROM kept
)
SELECT
  kept.equipref,
  kept.avg_h AS avg_humidity,
  kept.avg_h - kept.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall,
  ABS(kept.avg_h - kept_mean.kmean) AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept, kept_mean
WHERE kept.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND kept_mean.kmean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean IS NULL, diff_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
